Welcome, adventurer.
This land holds more than the old stories tell: monsters that steal, cast or grow stronger wave after wave, quests posted on the Notice Board every day, an Arena that never closes and much more.

The Adventurer's Guide will teach you each of them when it becomes part of your journey. There is nothing to click yet: when a new lesson is ready, a blinking question mark appears on your screen and the chat tells you what it is about. Click the question mark to read the lesson. If you don't see one, type .guide: new lessons wait there too.

Every lesson you were given can be read again in the Guidebook: type .guide in the chat, or press Alt+B and choose Adventurer's Guide on the Community Board.

Don't need the tips? Turn the pop-ups off on the Community Board's guide page, or type .guide off.
